take: AR49, C the stage: research's pick (2026-11-19, 23:54) with its four must-fixes
units: points; every box is left, top, width, height from the glass's top left; images at 4 pixels a point

panel.place: its left max(the lead's card's right + 8, the phone's middle - half its width), and never past the phone's right less 6; its foot 9 over the dock's top
panel.dimNote: the world under Home dims to 0.6 toward #05090B, the dock left lit; the HUD's corner pieces fade with it (the glass would cut the pills mid-word)

order: bottom to top as `images` lists them; a press image shows only while its card is held

HomeGlass.use: the panel's dark glass, its shadow faded inside its pad

HomePointer.use: the point down at Home's tile, its box's middle on the tile's middle

HomeVoidkinBack.use: the Voidkin card's dark ground and its shadow

HomeVoidkinGlow.use: the rarity's back glow, white: ImageColor3 the lead's light

HomeVoidkinRimTop.use: the rim's top edge, white, under the live view so the head rises in front of it: ImageColor3 the lead's light

HomeVoidkinFrame.use: over the live view: the glass where the view's box spills past the card's sides, the shade in from the sides, the dark at the foot

HomeVoidkinRim.use: the rim's sides and foot, white, over the live view: ImageColor3 the lead's light

HomeEquipment.use: the Equipment card whole: the forge, the ring, the blade, the jewel, the emblem, the binding, the rim

HomeSettings.use: the Settings card, its cog the kit's HomeMarkSettings over it

HomeVoidkinPress.use: the press, white: ImageColor3 the lead's light

HomeEquipmentPress.use: the press, white: ImageColor3 the forge's #FF8A3D

HomeSettingsPress.use: the press, white: ImageColor3 the steel's #AEB7C2

liveView.framing: the lead's own model in its idle, waist up: its hair's top 14 points over the card's top (-6), its belt 6 over the card's foot, its head on the card's middle; turned 34 degrees to its right, the head brought back 22 (the portrait's pose)
liveView.light: LightColor the lead's light, LightDirection from behind and above (the rim); Ambient #B4B8C2 so the face stays the brightest thing on the card

lightsNote: the lead's light: Config.Hud.Card.Trim lifted 40% toward white, so Common's grey still lights
wordsNote: TextLabels in the kit's face, bold and italic (leaning with the cards); x, y their capitals' top left (Settings' its middle); a soft dark copy under each, 0.8 right and 1.2 down, at #000000

ring.note: Equipment's art is one image; +7 is a label, for the build to keep or bind

press: the kit's lit press: the card's press image shown while held, with the dock's squeeze
